purpose: Provide one concise, sanitized operating contract for the exact LR3e-5 Qwen3.8 teacher-SFT development continuation from accepted step 6 through terminal step 76.

authority.required_before_use: The current standing user authorization and every listed live pre-submit gate must still hold. This record alone authorizes neither submission nor cancellation, deletion, retry, requeue, preemption, production promotion, evaluation or automation changes.

cluster_contract.physical_node_count_rule: After admission count distinct node names for this run's exact Pods. The two four-GPU workers may co-locate on one eight-GPU node; do not assume one or two physical nodes before binding the Pods.

live_pre_submit_gates: Fresh Nebius authority must cover preview, startup, the bounded run, terminal evidence and release reconciliation without exposing its token.
Reconstruct the exact plan, request, PREPARED receipt and runtime bundle; every digest above must match before use.
Reopen and validate the corpus and checkpoint manifests and independently rehash all 33 source-checkpoint files; the source must remain unchanged.
Run the pinned-image zero-GPU CPU preflight and independently validate its digest-bound receipt.
Obtain a warning-free authenticated dev preview that renders c1 to q1 value 10000, two workers by four GPUs, the exact image and resources, no requeue and shutdown on exit.
Prove the request name, output root, prepared root, W&B run ID, submission journal and Kubernetes identities are absent, with no accepted, active or ambiguous duplicate scientific cell.
Recheck live dev capacity and prove active owned physical nodes plus at most two requested nodes cannot exceed eight; never touch peer work.
Write one durable pre-POST intent, issue at most one Jobs API POST, preserve an ambiguous response without retry, and bind every returned immutable identity before interpreting state.

monitor_contract.queue_rule: Queued without an allocation has no GPU-idle clock and is not a reason to duplicate, requeue, force admission or touch peers.

idle_requires_all: the 1800-second runtime startup allowance has elapsed
PROGRESS, ACTIVITY and checkpoint fingerprints have not changed for at least 1200 seconds
aggregate GPU utilization is available and below 1 percent
process I/O is available and advanced by less than 1 MiB per internal sample
runtime_bounds.authoritative_stall_signal: A digest-valid WATCHDOG.json naming confirmed_no_progress_idle or hard_runtime_bound, reconciled with exact UID-bound live state.

read_only_observations: Jobs API state and immutable run ID
RayJob, Workload, RayCluster and Pod names, UIDs, ownership, conditions and timestamps
Pod readiness, exit state and restart counts
effective priority, worker shape and distinct physical node count
sanitized receipt presence, self-digest, optimizer step and checkpoint file-count or byte-count summaries
aggregate GPU utilization, model memory, process-I/O availability and output modification times
forbidden_observations_or_output: prompts, traces, flags, answers, task content or held-out benchmark material
private trainer logs or process command lines
raw tensors, optimizer values, samples or scores
material_notifications: The single POST is accepted or its response is ambiguous; include only the generated API name or ID and digest bindings.
The run is admitted and exact controller, Workload, RayCluster and Pod UIDs are bound, or topology, priority, image or ownership differs from preview.
STARTED and RECOVERED receipts validate, or recovery differs from exact step 6 and eight ranks.
The first new optimizer step 7 completes and each new checkpoint receipt appears at the frozen cadence.
A restart, preemption, nonfinite metric, tracking defect, stale progress suspicion, WATCHDOG state, FAILED receipt, nonzero exit or controller disagreement occurs.
Terminal step 76, W&B completion and the terminal checkpoint receipt validate, or any required terminal evidence is missing.
All exact owned objects and all eight GPUs release, or release remains uncertain after five minutes of one-minute terminal reconciliation.
routine_quiet_states: unchanged queue state without an allocation
healthy step progress between checkpoint milestones
one missing utilization sample without other failure evidence
unchanged terminal evidence after release was already proven

after_step76_success: Validate all terminal receipts against the exact plan and immutable UIDs.
Create and independently verify a no-replace CPU checkpoint seal with a complete file-by-file rehash.
Run a separate exact-topology all-rank zero-optimizer reload that restores model, optimizer, scheduler, random-number state, sampler and supervised-token progress.
Prove the source step-6 checkpoint remains unchanged and no checkpoint is written by the reload.
Reconcile Jobs API, RayJob, Workload, RayCluster and Pod state until all exact owned GPU allocations are absent.
terminal_and_release_contract.release_action_rule: Preserve evidence first. A separate live operator with current authority may release only this exact owned broken or confirmed-stalled allocation through the Jobs API. Never delete to hide a failure, never touch peers, and never retry automatically.
